title: Set up the estimate
text: Every derivative of $$e^{\left(-x\right)}$$ is plus or minus $$e^{\left(-x\right)}$$, which is largest at $$x=-3$$, so $$M=e^3$$. Since $$|x| \leq 3$$ on the interval, we need $$e^3 3^{n+1}$$ divided by the factorial of $$n+1$$ to be at most $$\frac{1}{1000}$$.

title: Test values of $$n$$
text: For $$n=13$$ the bound is about $$0.0011$$, which is too big, and for $$n=14$$ it is about $$0.00022$$. So the smallest $$n$$ is $$14$$.
